answer: Goal: Sybil resistance in agent economy. Clones cannot diverge: If attacker clones an agent, identical copies cannot independently choose divergent random paths without differing state. Mechanism can force per-identity divergence: each identity must maintain a private evolving route (spiral) seeded by hardware timing (quartz) and report delta between checkpoints. Clones from same base cannot diverge without paying separate physical randomness/hardware or computation.
